description: Full detail for one maintenance job: the task checklist with per-task completion, assignee and spare-part requirement, the printer's stats since its last maintenance, the problems linked to the job, and other unresolved problems on the same printer. Task checklists and spare-part requirements are available nowhere else over MCP. Pass the job id as job_id (list_maintenance_jobs returns it as "id"); each task's id is what the task tools take as task_id.
name: get_maintenance_job
